biggest_catch: Both payments are per couple, not per person — $80 or $100 for two people's time, and you must be in a couple willing to participate together plus pass screening.

numeric_basis: payout from official UH terms ($80 and $100 per couple); time: stated session lengths — study 2 ~1h questionnaires + 1.5h Zoom per partner (~150 min/person); study 1 1.5h questionnaires + 3h in-person visit (~270 min active).
payout_quote: The first research study is focused on how couples handle conflict. Couples receive $80 for their participation, which includes online questionnaires (1.5 hours) and an in-person couples visit to our lab at the University of Houston (3 hours). The second research study is fully remote and investigates the role of personality in romantic relationships. Couples receive $100 for their participation, which includes online questionnaires (1 hour) and a separate Zoom appointment (1.5 hours) for each member of the couple.
payout_value_note: Per couple (not per person): $80 for study 1, $100 for study 2; cash-equivalent assumed cash.

steps: Go to the University of Houston Center for Couples Therapy page and read the 'Participate in Paid Research in our Lab' section
Pick one of the two paid couples studies: conflict study ($80) or remote personality study ($100)
Complete the study's eligibility survey (Qualtrics link on the page)
If eligible, the research team contacts you and schedules the sessions
Complete the questionnaires (and the 3-hour in-person lab visit for study 1, or the two 1.5-hour Zoom appointments for study 2) to earn the stated payment
timing: Study 1: ~4.5 hours total (1.5h questionnaires + 3h in-person). Study 2: ~1h questionnaires + 1.5h Zoom per partner (~2.5h per person). Payment timing/method not stated on the page.
